[SWS_DM_01051] DM behavior on transmission Mode stopSending without periodicDataIdentifier in the request
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service
ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmissionMode set to ’stopSending’ and
no periodicDataIdentifier in the request, the DM shall stop all scheduled periodic-
DataIdentifier transmissions.
⌋
